title: Fashion Merchandiser
description:
Seeking a Fashion Merchandiser for our retail brand. Key Responsibilities:
- Analyze market trends and consumer buying habits to forecast fashion trends.
- Plan and develop seasonal collections and inventory strategies.
- Collaborate with designers and suppliers to source materials and products.
- Optimize pricing and promotional strategies to maximize sales.
Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Fashion Merchandising, Business, or related field.
- Experience in retail merchandising or buying.
- Strong analytical and negotiation skills.
- Passion for fashion and retail trends.
